answer: Each identity takes a delta-ladder rung in the meadow ledger, staking 80 credits on a fable, a work log under an umber seal. Each epoch it files a fresh fable of work; auditors replay the table, and a copied fable, reused seal, or missed rung burns it. First rung 40, kth 40+7(k-1): the 1,000th is 7,033, so 1,000 fakes pay 3,536,500 for a 40,000 pool. Rented-ladder rings fail: one key holds no two rungs. Honest climbers pay 40 once and keep it.
